notes: Source is the managing company's own report (הפניקס פנסיה וגמל בע"מ, a subsidiary of the listed Phoenix Financial), not the parent's report; no parent figures were used.

Segment keys follow the printed columns of the activity tables (תיאור עסקי התאגיד / ריכוז תוצאות הפעילות): pension_veteran = קרנות פנסיה ותיקות (column 'יסוד'; includes Yesod, Magen and the Lawyers' pension fund per the assets table), pension_new_comprehensive = קרנות פנסיה חדשות - מקיפה, pension_new_general = קרנות פנסיה חדשות - משלימה (כללית), provident_gemel = קופת גמל לתגמולים ואישית לפיצויים, provident_study_fund = קרן השתלמות, provident_investment = קופת גמל להשקעה, provident_child_savings = קופת גמל להשקעה לחיסכון ארוך טווח לילד, provident_central_severance = מרכזית לפיצויים, provident_central_annuity = מרכזיות לקצבה, other = אחר, total = סך הכל (all funds managed by the company). The report prints no aggregate 'new pension' or 'provident' column in these tables; pension_new = comprehensive + general and provident = sum of the provident columns (incl. central funds and 'other') must be built downstream, nothing was summed here.

Amounts in NIS thousands as printed (אלפי ש"ח); rates in percent as printed (tables print 0.14 or 0.14%); members/accounts are counts; adjusted_ebitda is quoted in NIS millions from the directors' report text. Values are exactly as printed; a printed '-' is stored as 0 with note "printed as '-'"; parentheses are stored as negative numbers.

Activity-table windows: the report is cumulative from 1 January. FY report = full-year columns (window fy) and balance-date columns (instant); Q1 table = 3 months (window q, equal to ytd); Q2 table = 6 months and Q3 table = 9 months (window ytd). Each report also prints the prior-year same-period block and the FY2023 (or two further prior years) block; all are taken with their own date. The activity tables are not printed for the stand-alone quarter in Q2/Q3; quarter-only (3 months) figures exist only for the income statement and segment note.

management_fees_from_assets / management_fees_from_deposits are amounts collected (דמי ניהול שנגבו) in the activity table, split by fund type; they differ slightly from the accrual 'הכנסות מדמי ניהול' in the income statement (metric management_fees). Average fee rates are printed by population only (פעילים, לא פעילים, מקבלי קצבה) and per fund type, with no all-population rate: metrics fee_rate_from_assets_active / _inactive / _pensioners and fee_rate_from_deposits (rate on deposits).

transfers_in / transfers_out are the printed 'העברות צבירה לקרן/לקופה' and 'העברות צבירה מהקרן/מהקופה' (gross, per fund type; the report does not say whether transfers between tracks inside a fund are included and prints no separate between-tracks line). withdrawals = 'פדיונות'. Pension annuity payments are printed separately and were not extracted.

Income statement and segment note (ניהול קרנות פנסיה / ניהול קופות גמל): segment pension and provident come from the consolidated operating segments note; segment total equals the consolidated statement (checked: pension + provident = total for every row and window). management_fees for segment total is the combined line 'הכנסות מדמי ניהול מקרנות פנסיה וקופות גמל, נטו' of the directors' report where printed. selling_and_marketing_expenses is the line 'עמלות, הוצאות שיווק והוצאות רכישה אחרות', which per the commissions note includes the amortisation of deferred acquisition costs net of the acquisition costs deferred in the year; the amortisation itself (dac_amortisation, additions, balance by segment) is printed only in the annual reports. gains_credited_to_guaranteed_return_track_members = 'רווחים שנזקפו לעמיתי מסלולי קופות הגמל מבטיחי תשואה' (a pass-through to track members, shown among expenses). No line named operating profit is printed; profit_before_tax and the adjusted EBITDA of the directors' report are the closest items.

members = מספר עמיתים as printed; the footnote of the table says that for provident funds the number of member accounts is reported and for pension funds the number of members, with active and inactive defined per the regulator. Rows without a printed label (fees collected from deposits, average fee rate from deposits) carry the section header as label.

Document located through the public static file host digital-content.fnx.co.il (file name pattern doch_kaspi_pensia_q<N>_<YY>.pdf, same as the 2022 Q3 report indexed by search). The company's report-index page (fnx.co.il/pension-savings/fnx-pension-ltd/finncial-reports/) loads the list from an iframe protected by a Radware bot challenge; it was not opened or bypassed. MAYA was not used: the managing company does not report there (its parent does).
The FY2023 report prints blocks for 31.12.2023, 31.12.2022 and 31.12.2021. The 2021 figures include the merged Helman Aldovi funds from 1 October 2021 (as footnoted in the report).

Source inconsistencies as printed: transfers_out total 31.12.2023 = 16,596,786 while the columns sum to 16,595,786; management_fees_from_assets total 31.12.2021 = 636,217 while the columns sum to 363,217; members_active/inactive and accounts_inactive 31.12.2021 totals exclude the 'other'/central-annuity columns (grey cells).
2021 block: the page headed 'מספר חשבונות עמיתים' (accounts) is stored as accounts_active / accounts_inactive; members (מספר עמיתים) is the other page.
